name: Spreadsheets
description: Create and inspect portable XLSX spreadsheets and analyze CSV data.
instructions: Use write_xlsx with a JSON array of objects for named columns or an array of arrays for an explicit table.
Preserve numeric and boolean values as their original JSON types instead of converting every cell to text.
After creation, call read_office_document and verify headers, row count, key values, sheet name, and requested filename.
Use csv_preview for existing CSV data. Do not claim formulas, charts, macros, or styling unless they were explicitly produced and verified.
